title: Branchwell plan and declaration validation
summary: The dedicated branch checks that the Branchwell plan exists and that Lydite declarations pass inventory validation. The workflow prints the Lydite checkout and reports consumer case execution as pending.
acceptance_criteria: Run the plan and inventory checks on public Ubuntu.
State in the result that Branchwell case execution needs consumer evidence.

evidence.claim: The hosted validation passed the plan and inventory step at the recorded branch tip.
